details.reasoning: The answer gives the gold count of seven and identifies seven stations served by the A Line and at least one other Metro Rail line.
details.groundedness_reasoning: The citation identifies five A/E shared stations. It also identifies Union Station as an additional A Line connection with the B and D Lines; although 7th/Metro is also a B/D transfer, that station is already among the five A/E stations. Willowbrook/Rosa Parks is another station, where the A Line meets the C Line. Thus the distinct stations total five plus Union Station plus Willowbrook/Rosa Parks, or seven.
